title: Westside Dance
specs: Two annual performances at Marjorie Luke Theatre
Specialty camps with performances and parade participation
No annual registration, enrollment fees or hidden costs
Sibling discounts 15% off total tuition for monthly students
PreBallet age 3-6 for drop-in community class
Hair up and specific leotard and skirt colors per ballet level
Birthday party package for up to 15 kids
includes: Costume fee and tickets for performances
Tables, chairs, and dance props for birthday parties
Counselor shirt and participation as CIT/counselor for leadership camp
gap: Age minimum not stated for most classes except drop-in PreBallet
blurb: Westside Dance offers ballet classes for children from preschool age through advanced levels, with monthly tuition and no hidden fees. They also host special events such as birthday parties, dance parties, and seasonal camps with performances. Classes focus on skill building, creativity, and fun, with opportunities for performance and community engagement.
extraNote: Tuition due on first class of the month or full session upfront · Missed classes can be made up within the same month; no deductions for next month · Cancelled drop-in classes posted on homepage Friday evening · Buy tickets for performances at theatre day of show ($20 adults, $15 kids)
